Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. The resilience comes from slashing: dishonest approval costs more than the gain from a single manipulated verdict, so rational attackers stay honest. Consider a lotus as the anchor of the cost.
